mission_03: UMAP (Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection) is a modern dimensionality reduction technique that combines the cluster visualization strength of t-SNE with better preservation of global structure and faster computation. UMAP is based on manifold learning and topological data analysis, making it suitable for both visualization and as a preprocessing step for machine learning. In this mission, you will apply UMAP to a 20-dimensional dataset and compare its properties with t-SNE. UMAP is increasingly preferred over t-SNE in production pipelines due to its speed and scalability.
